components.css: .ds-btn-pair { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-btn-ok, .ds-btn-danger { padding: 6px 11px; border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ok { background: var(--btn-ok-bg, #0F766E); border: 1px solid var(--btn-ok-bg, #0F766E); } .ds-btn-ok:hover { background: var(--btn-ok-hover, #065F46); border-color: var(--btn-ok-hover, #065F46); } .ds-btn-danger { background: var(--btn-danger-bg, #C81E1E); border: 1px solid var(--btn-danger-bg, #C81E1E); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--btn-danger-hover, #991B1B); border-color: var(--btn-danger-hover, #991B1B); } .ds-btn-ok:focus-visible, .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #005FB8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 280px; } .ds-field label { font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-secondary, #334155); } .ds-field input { height: 38px; padding: 6px 10px; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #0F172A); border: 1px solid var(--border, #CBD5E1); border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); font-size: 0.85rem; caret-color: var(--accent, #005FB8); transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-muted, #475569); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #005FB8); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #005FB8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Left Switchgear Navy rail navigation buttons pairing inline 1.75px SVG icons with tabular counts or role tags.
components.css: .ds-rail { width: 248px; padding: 12px; background: var(--rail-bg, #0F294A); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); } .ds-rail-item { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); color: #CBD5E1; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-rail-item.active { background: var(--accent, #005FB8); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #93C5FD; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail-lbl { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-rail-tag { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); color: #FFFFFF; }

narrative.overview:
This design system transforms a German-Swiss electrical engineering switchgear catalog (Eaton / Moeller specification binder style) into an air-gapped operational SCADA interface for university electrical engineering labs and industrial switchboard rooms. Light-first porcelain worksheets maximize daylight readability under overhead fluorescent lighting, while an authoritative Switchgear Navy navigation shell frames system status, role authority, and RS-485 bus controls cleanly without visual noise.

Across both the authentication gate (/login) and multi-device telemetry desk (/), information density is governed by crisp 1px steel hairlines, flat porcelain figure-ground separation, IEC three-phase signal discipline, and right-aligned tabular numerals (tabular-nums). The system deliberately rejects dark-slate glowing neon aesthetics, nested SaaS sub-cards, decorative thick accent stripes, and external CDN dependencies so every telemetry frame renders instantaneously offline.
keyCharacteristics: Light-default Porcelain Lab Canvas (#F7F8FA) paired with pure white data sheets (#FFFFFF) and a committed Switchgear Navy left rail (#0F294A), plus a calibrated per-user dark-room polarity (#0C131D / #131C2B).
Zero-CDN system typography using "Segoe UI" for Romanian prose and "Cascadia Mono" (tabular-nums) strictly for electrical readings, Modbus register addresses, timestamps, and numeric badges.
Flat structural sheets divided internally by 1px steel borders (#CBD5E1) and hairlines (#E2E8F0) with a disciplined 4px technical corner radius.

Calibrated IEC three-phase waveform palette (#005FB8, #B45309, #0F766E, #6D28D9, #475569) paired with separate high-contrast solid control inks (>= 4.5:1 with white labels) across both Light and Dark themes.
Custom High-DPI HTML5 Canvas plots and RS-485 topology / Ir overcurrent load ruler components with zero third-party chart or icon packages.

rules.name: The Polarity Contrast Split Rule
rules.body: Never paint a bright dark-mode foreground pen (#3898EC, #34D399, #F87171) behind #FFFFFF button labels. Solid controls in dark theme bind to dedicated deep surface fills (--btn-accent-bg: #0B66C3, --btn-ok-bg: #0F766E, --btn-danger-bg: #C81E1E) to guarantee >= 4.5:1 legibility.

rules.name: The Semantic Non-Collision Rule
rules.body: Keep I_G earth-fault traces on neutral steel slate (#475569 / #CBD5E1) and admin role pills in Cobalt .info, reserving Crimson (--danger) exclusively for Prag Ir overcurrent thresholds and fault alarms and Teal (--ok) for active/normal operational health.

rules.name: The Monospace Discipline Rule
rules.body: Apply .mono (font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;) exclusively to electrical quantities, Modbus register addresses, ISO/local timestamps, usernames/IDs, and numeric counters — never to surrounding Romanian prose labels.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet-No-Nesting Rule
rules.body: Partition content inside .sheet exclusively with 1px solid var(--border) / var(--border-subtle) internal grid lines (.simple-columns, .charts-grid, .indicators-grid, .ledger-rows), removing redundant outer-edge hairlines (border-right: none, border-bottom: none on trailing grid rows/columns) instead of nesting bordered cards inside cards.

dos: Do keep 4px crisp technical corners (--radius) on all sheets, buttons, inputs, badges, and rail navigation items across light and dark modes.
Do enforce 14px flex/grid gaps between top-level .sheet and .hw-bar blocks while using 1px internal hairlines inside sheets (removing trailing bottom/right grid borders).

Do pair bright dark-mode accents (#3898EC, #34D399, #F87171) exclusively with borders, chart lines, and dark-surface text; use dedicated --btn-accent-bg (#0B66C3), --btn-ok-bg (#0F766E), and --btn-danger-bg (#C81E1E) behind #FFFFFF button labels.
Do restrict .mono and font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums strictly to numeric measurements, addresses, IDs, counters, and timestamps.
Do render all icons as inline stroke-width="1.75" SVGs and keep HTML templates 100% self-contained with zero external URLs or CDN imports (Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self').
donts: Don't add glowing neon gradients, blurred glassmorphism panels, heavy box-shadow depth cards, or nested bordered cards inside .sheet containers.
Don't use thick colored left/right border stripes (3px-4px) on alerts, banners, or KPI cells; communicate state through 1px semantic borders, subtle tinted backgrounds, and crisp SVG/pill marks.
Don't use raw Unicode emoji or symbol glyphs for UI buttons or alert indicators, and don't add decorative uppercase kickers above section titles.
Don't share Crimson (--danger) between Prag Ir limit thresholds and I_G earth-fault telemetry curves or allow negative Y-axis margin padding on inherently non-negative electrical series.
